polling.pausedClick: Sensor polling is paused - click to resume
polling.pausedClickReason: Sensor polling is paused ({{reason}}) - click to resume
polling.menuHelp: Pauses sensor polling. Relay boards keep their 15 s heartbeat poll so the firmware fail-safe cannot trip.
polling.pausedUntilResumed: Sensor polling paused until you resume it.

timers.menuHelp: These relays are scheduled to switch by themselves. Either stop button cancels all of them.

error.forbidden: Your account is not permitted to run this action. Nothing was switched off.
error.notSupported: This controller build does not support that action yet. Nothing was switched off.
error.failed: {{message}}. Relays may still be energised - stop them at the panel.

result.boardsNotConfirmed: {{failed}} did NOT confirm all channels off and may still be energised: {{detail}}. Check them physically.
result.sweepIncomplete: The relay sweep did not complete. Relays may still be energised - stop them at the panel.
result.sweepIncompleteError: The relay sweep did not complete ({{error}}). Relays may still be energised - stop them at the panel.
result.unconfirmed: The controller accepted the stop but never reported the result ({{done}}/{{total}} boards confirmed before it went quiet). Relays may still be energised - check them at the panel.

stopAll.label: Stop all
stopAll.tooltip: Stop All - switches EVERY relay OFF on every board, including ALL fans and climate relays, and cancels all pending timers. Automations stay armed and may re-fire. To stop only irrigation (fans keep running), use Stop irrigation on the dashboard Irrigation card.
stopAll.aria: Stop all: switch every relay off on every board, including all fans and climate relays, and cancel pending timers, leaving automations armed. Use Stop irrigation to stop only irrigation.
stopAll.resultSuffix: ALL fans and climate relays are OFF too — switch them back on if they should run. (To stop only irrigation, use Stop irrigation on the dashboard Irrigation card.) Automations stay armed and may re-fire.
stopAll.unreachable: Could not reach the controller ({{error}}). Nothing is confirmed stopped - use the physical panel.

estop.label: Emergency stop
estop.tooltip: EMERGENCY STOP - switches ALL relays OFF on every board (including all fans and climate), cancels every pending timer, and disarms automations so nothing re-fires. To stop only irrigation use Stop irrigation on the dashboard.
estop.tooltipDisarmed: Automations are DISARMED. Choosing a duration stops everything again and extends the disarm.
estop.aria: Emergency stop: switch all relays off and disarm automations
estop.menuAria: Emergency stop - keep automations disarmed for
estop.menuHelp: Switches every relay off on every board — including ALL fans and climate relays — cancels all pending timers, and disarms automations so nothing re-fires. No climate control or irrigation runs while disarmed. To stop only irrigation, use Stop irrigation on the dashboard Irrigation card.
estop.resultSuffixUntilReArm: Automations stay disarmed until you re-arm them.
estop.unreachable: Could not reach the controller ({{error}}). Nothing is confirmed stopped and automations may still be armed - use the physical panel.

rearm.forbidden: Your account is not permitted to re-arm automations. They are still disarmed.
rearm.success: Automations are armed again and will run on schedule.
rearm.unreachable: Could not reach the controller ({{error}}). Automations are still disarmed.

disarmedBanner.title: Automations are disarmed.
disarmedBanner.body: Nothing will re-fire — no climate control, irrigation or fertigation is running until they are re-armed.

pollingBanner.title: Sensor polling is paused.
pollingBanner.body: Sensor readings are not being recorded. Relay boards keep their 15 s heartbeat poll so the firmware fail-safe cannot trip.
